hero.header: Out of love for my own instruments grew a love for my clients' instruments.
hero.email-button: Send an email

location.header: So where is the service located?
location.subheader: Right in the center of Wrocław – on the picturesque Tęczowa Street, number 81
location.paragraph: The workshop is located on the first floor of a loft-style brick building. One of its distinctive features is an old yellow acoustic guitar displayed in the workshop window. The entrance is on the right-hand side of the building and can be recognized by its brown wooden door.

pricing.subheader: This seemingly nonsensical phrase contains the names of service packages I’ve prepared especially for you as part of my offer.

p1.subheader: A few months AGO at Gitar Serwis
p1.paragraph: If your instrument has visited Gitar Serwis within the last 6 months, the price of this package will be the most attractive. I recommend using the services at least twice a year, which will ensure your instrument’s performance and care. Regular check-ups guarantee that your instrument will remain in perfect condition.

p2.subheader: I don’t want CHEAP, I want quality
p2.paragraph: In this package, I will take care of your instrument as if it were my own. I will check every detail and make the necessary adjustments. I recommend this package for owners of exceptionally valuable guitars and vintage models that require special attention.

p3.paragraph: If you have no idea when your instrument last entered the doors of an experienced service shop, it probably needs significant adjustments. I suggest the SPA* package, including minor repairs, replacement of electronic components, and adjustment of settings to your needs. All this and more can be found in this comprehensive package for your guitar.

pricing.footer: *Gitar Serwis SPA includes cleaning and maintenance with special oils, complemented by an instrument massage (play-in).

services.subheader: Why Gitar Serwis is the choice that respects your needs and cares for every detail

s1.paragraph: I have great respect for the Elixir company, which is why I use their strings for replacements at Gitar Serwis. I have nothing against your preferences and will gladly install the set you like and respect as well.

s2.paragraph: If you DO NOT want your guitar to be cleaned and conditioned, the service cost increases by 30% of the original price.

s3.paragraph: When working with instruments, I use the highest quality tools, which allow me to achieve precision and ensure the safety of the repairs.

a1.subheader: Gitar Serwis is a clinic for instruments, which is why we've also prepared for urgent and unexpected situations!
a1.paragraph: If you've noticed that something is wrong with your instrument, and there are only a few days or hours left before a concert or recording, don't worry, there's a good chance everything will work out. Feel free to contact me by phone for emergency service or to have your instrument checked. Please call during reasonable hours, unless the situation demands otherwise.

a2.header: Hands-On Guitar Service – Book an Appointment!
a2.paragraph:
At Gitar Serwis, the most popular service option is an in-person workshop session, during which we can perform most repairs and adjustments on the spot. It’s not just a quick repair—it’s also an opportunity to learn more about your instrument and how to take proper care of it.

Want to change your strings, adjust the neck, or fix the electronics? This hands-on service is for you.

In a friendly and relaxed atmosphere, we’ll carry out the necessary work and set up your instrument according to your preferences, ensuring it feels and plays exactly the way you want. You’ll also learn how to maintain your guitar so it sounds great and stays in excellent condition for years to come.

Price: PLN 200 per hour of service.

about.subheader: If you've made it this far, you deserve a bonus or even a few!
about.paragraph:
By using the code GITARSERWIS, you'll get a 20% discount on the purchase of FreakyCables cables or on custom orders from HaieWire.

After a successful service, you're invited to leave a Google review. As a thank you, you'll receive a 25% discount coupon for a selected package at Gitar Serwis. You can use the discount yourself or give it as a gift to others.
